notes.title: FISHTOPIA Update v1.2.6 Announcement
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We have now released the following updates:


1.Fixed an issue causing achievement descriptions to be inconsistent with their unlock conditions.

2.Fixed an issue causing incorrect creature names in certain languages.

3.Fixed an issue causing incorrect creature descriptions in certain languages.

4.Fixed various text layout issues in certain languages.

5.Fixed an issue that could cause creatures to stutter or freeze in the main scene.

notes.title: FISHTOPIA Update v1.2.2 Announcement
notes.content:
Hi everyone,


We have now released the following updates:


1.Fixed an issue where the displayed gold cost for unlocking the next area did not match the actual amount paid.

2.Fixed an issue where the skill for creature #184 was not taking effect.

3.Fixed an issue where the skills for creatures #120, #121, #169, #170, #219, #220, #252, #253, #272, #273, #290, #291, #301, and #302 would not deactivate under certain conditions.

notes.title: FISHTOPIA Update v1.1.3 Announcement
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We have now released the following updates:


1.Added Exit Guide for Wallpaper Mode

We have added a tutorial on how to exit Wallpaper Mode. You will see the guide after updating the game and entering this mode.

Reminder: You can always exit Wallpaper Mode by clicking the FISHTOPIA icon in your system tray (at the bottom-right corner of your desktop).


2.Fixed Steam Achievement Sync Issue

Fixed an issue where achievements earned in-game were not displayed or synced correctly with the Steam client.


3.Fixed "Glittering Seahorse" Skill Bonus

Resolved an issue where the skill bonus for the "Glittering Seahorse" was not applying correctly.


4.Fixed Demo Save File Import Issue

The issue that prevented demo save files from being carried over to the full version has been resolved. You can now click "Continue" on the main menu to successfully load your progress from the demo.

notes.title: v0.9.5 FISHTOPIA DEMO Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We've rolled out an update with some new features to make your gaming experience more convenient and enjoyable.

Here are the details of this update:


Quality of Life Updates
New One-Click Collect Button: We've added a button in the bottom-right corner of the game window to instantly collect all your Gold and Crystals. Gathering your earnings is now easier than ever!

New Offline Earnings Summary: You can now find an offline earnings summary in the bottom-right corner. It displays the total amount of uncollected Gold and Crystals, allowing you to easily track your income while you were away or idle.


DEMO Save Transfer
We've always wanted FISHTOPIA to be a cozy corner for you in your busy life. It’s a place where you can simply relax and be happy, free from stressful tasks, enjoying your own healing moments.



Every landscape you've created and every creature you've nurtured in the DEMO is a part of that wonderful experience. We believe your valuable progress and the memories you've made shouldn't be lost.



That's why we've made it possible to carry your DEMO save data over to the full version of the game. We want the joy and warmth you found in the DEMO to continue seamlessly into the complete world of FISHTOPIA.



Once the full game launches, just download it to have your save data transferred automatically. If you encounter any issues with your save file, please contact us via our Discord.

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/Ey3Hpm4aeb



Thank you for your support! We can't wait to see you in the full version!

notes.title: v0.9 FISHTOPIA DEMO Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Thanks to all your passionate feedback, we've implemented several optimizations and feature updates. We're excited to roll out the v0.9 DEMO, and we hope these changes bring you even more enjoyment.


Here are the details of this update:

Experience Optimizations
Wider Interaction Range: We've expanded the auto-collection range for Gold and Crystals, as well as the click-box for juvenile creatures, making every interaction smoother and easier.

Clearer Icon Guidance: We've added hover tooltips to all in-game icons, making it easier for you to understand the function of each button.

More Convenient Collection System: Now, when you exit the game, the system will automatically collect all Gold and Crystals on the map, ensuring none of your hard work goes to waste.

Resizable Game Window: You can now freely resize and adjust the game window to the dimensions that best suit your screen and preferences.

Personalization and New Features
New decoration management Feature is Live: The new decoration management tool is here! Now you can more easily browse, select, and arrange your beloved decorations to create your own unique deep-sea landscape.

A More Comfortable Visual Experience: In Options, we've added the Lower Brightness and Close CRT Scanlines settings. You can now adjust the display for a more comfortable visual experience.

Fixes and Adjustments
More Stable Inventory System: This update fixes issues where the inventory would occasionally experience display errors and data lag. Your assets and items will now be displayed more accurately.

Game Content Fixes: Adjusted some items in the shop and fixed an issue where some creature skill effects were incorrect.

Improved Multilingual Support: Fixed bugs causing poor text formatting and display errors in some language settings, leading to an improved localization experience.


Thank you again for your support and for being part of our journey! We hope you enjoy your time in FISHTOPIA!

notes.title: FISHTOPIA DEMO Update v0.6.1 Announcement
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you for exploring in the world of FISHTOPIA. To make this aquatic world even more vibrant and engaging, we're excited to bring you the v0.6.1 DEMO update. We hope these new changes will make your underwater journey even more rich and delightful.



Here are the details of this update:
A More Accessible Experience
A Warmer Welcome: To help new players dive in smoothly, we've refined the tutorial and prepared a small gift for you upon completion.

A Smoother Start to Your Collection: We've rebalanced Area 1 to make the initial stages of your journey easier and more enjoyable.

Easier Card Inspection: You can now simply hold down Tab to get a detailed look at your cards.


New Gameplay Features
New Creature Abilities: Some creatures have now awakened their own unique skills, which might just bring some unexpected surprises to your card builds.

New Interactive Growth: You can now help your growing creatures mature faster with a gentle tap.


Visual & Audio Updates
More Satisfying Rewards: The production animations for Gold and Crystals have been updated in v0.6.1, making every harvest feel more delightful.

A Personalized Welcome: The game's launch screen has been refreshed! Now, you'll be greeted by your own familiar companions when you start the game.

A More Immersive Soundscape: We've polished some of the game's audio to bring you a more immersive auditory experience.


Communication & Feedback
A Direct Line to Us: This update adds an in-game Feedback button. Your every thought is invaluable to us, and we welcome you to share them anytime.



Dive back into this revitalized deep sea and continue to explore and create your own unique story. We can't wait to see you again in the world of FISHTOPIA!
